Subject: MAP Kickoff — SOC 2 evidence playbook & timeline

Hi Ana / BlueHarbor team,

Thanks for taking the time to spin up a MAP with us. I wanted to kick off this thread to introduce the stakeholders, align on roles, and share a lightweight "evidence playbook" that will guide collection and review. Our goal is to map expectations and hit a close timeline that works for both teams.

Key objectives for this MAP:
- Identify point people for each evidence area (GRC, infra, app, procurement)
- Share an evidence matrix with owner / ETA per item
- Agree on meeting cadence and an initial 6-week runbook to readiness

Suggested tentative timeline (can adjust):
1) Week 0 (this week): stakeholder intros, assign owners, share matrix
2) Week 1–3: evidence collection & attachments uploaded to shared drive
3) Week 4: Redwood review + clarifying questions
4) Week 5–6: final validation, sign-off, and DocuSign MPA execution

Attachments I’m sharing here: Redwood MAP playbook (v1) and the evidence matrix template. Please do not treat these as final — they’re a practical starting point so we can assign owners quickly.

Ask: can you confirm the primary GRC/security and procurement contacts on your side, plus any blackout dates in the next 3 weeks that would block review? I’d also like to book a 30-min kickoff this week to walk the matrix and confirm owners. My team’s suggested slots: 10/22 9:30–11:00 PDT or 10/23 14:00–16:00 PDT.

Next steps from Redwood (if we hear back by EOD):
- We’ll lock the kickoff slot and send a calendar invite with a shared Drive link
- Internal owners will pre-fill obvious items in the matrix so you see what we expect

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
